name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Aspect Ratio. No manga effect: it is a layout tool, so only the data-manga hook is added. Same API: pass a ratio (width / height) and the child fills the box.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/aspect-ratio". It wraps your own components/ui/aspect-ratio, so Radix and Base UI both work with the same ratio prop.

meta.tagline: A box of a fixed ratio for covers, panels and frames.
meta.usage: import { AspectRatio } from "@/components/ui/manga/aspect-ratio"
